description: The pie chart presents the distribution of items across subject categories for the dataset referenced in “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models,” showing 12 slices in total with labels connected by leader lines and percentages printed next to the labels (no separate legend and no exploded/offset slices). The largest slice is labeled “AI/NLP” in blue at about 24.3%. Other slices include “Fin” in teal (approximately one-fifth of the chart, exact percent not fully visible), “Game&Anime” in orange at about 8.2%, “History” in yellow at about 8.2%, “Daily Life” in light cyan at about 7.1%, “Science” in light blue at about 6.7%, “Med & Health” in pale yellow at about 6.7%, “Business” in red at about 5.9%, “Pet & Animal” in green at about 5.5%, “Law” in pink at about 5.1%, “Geography” in yellow-green at about 2.7%, and “Math” in green at about 1.2%; the slices appear arranged around the circle without an obvious strictly descending order by size.
